# Connecting what matters.
* [Solar & Energy][1]
* [Welding][2]

[In the center is a man in uniform with a Fronius welding machine, walking along a roof covered with
solar panels.]

## Making connections since 1945.

**Fronius is a global corporation specializing in **welding technology, photovoltaics, and battery
charging technology.**

Since **1945**, we have been developing solutions that stand for **quality, reliability, and
durability.** With around 6,500 employees in **37 subsidiaries,** we focus on innovation and
sustainability in order to provide our customers around the world with the best possible products
and services.

Guided by the principle of “Connecting what matters”, we connect people, materials, and energy to
build a **safe and sustainable world.**

Fronius Solar & Energy
Electricity is the thread that binds our business and our world together. By focusing on energy
sector integration, our solutions connect the sun with the grid, the grid with mobility, and energy
systems with efficiency.
[Discover Fronius Solar & Energy][3]
Fronius Welding
Our welding technology is designed to forge unbreakable bonds between metals for decades to come.
[Discover Fronius Welding][4]
About us
How did it all begin? Who are our customers? And how can you apply to join us? Discover our story.
[Learn more about us][5]
Latest news
In our press and news area you’ll find all the latest updates about our products and the company.
[Latest news & press releases][6]

## Our new product highlights

### Reserva—the Fronius storage solution

Use solar energy around the clock with the Fronius Reserva. The high-voltage battery with DC
coupling ensures a highly efficient energy transfer. Thanks to its modular capacity of 6.3 to 15.8
kWh, the Reserva can be flexibly adapted to your needs. Designed to work seamlessly with Fronius
hybrid inverters, it slots perfectly into your PV system. Your data remains secure on European
servers, while our proven service and support network is always there for you.

[Learn more about the Fronius Reserva][7]
[Fronius Reserva]

### Fronius Fortis—the next-gen manual MIG/MAG welding machine

Welding tasks are often a challenge, especially for small and medium-sized companies. Some of the
tasks change on a daily basis, as do the required welding processes. This calls for a welding
machine that can be adapted perfectly to these dynamic conditions.

[Learn more about the Fronius Fortis][8]
[Fronius Fortis]

## Fronius News

[Fronius employee]

## Fronius as an employer

As a family business, we are characterized by a special spirit—a sense of togetherness that shapes
our corporate culture. Whether in development, production, or our international teams, together we
embody “Connecting what matters” to create solutions that make a real difference today and tomorrow.
We are Fronius.

solar panels.]

## Making connections since 1945.

**Fronius is a global corporation specializing in **welding technology, photovoltaics, and battery
charging technology.**

Since **1945**, we have been developing solutions that stand for **quality, reliability, and
durability.** With around 6,500 employees in **37 subsidiaries,** we focus on innovation and
sustainability in order to provide our customers around the world with the best possible products
and services.

Guided by the principle of “Connecting what matters”, we connect people, materials, and energy to
build a **safe and sustainable world.**

Electricity is the thread that binds our business and our world together. By focusing on energy
sector integration, our solutions connect the sun with the grid, the grid with mobility, and energy

#### Features

## Maximize the benefits of your solar

Whether you want to meet safety codes, monitor your site at the module level, or reduce the impacts
of shade, Tigo has you covered.
Only Tigo quantifies the benefits of module-level optimization by showing Reclaimed Energy in its
monitoring portal.
[Tigo optimization icon yellow]

#### Optimization

##### Increase energy output

Tigo Optimizers maximize energy output from your array and minimizes the losses from shade, module
mismatch, degradation, and other issues. The Tigo Reclaimed Energy feature validates and visualizes
optimizer benefits.
[Tigo monitoring icon blue]

#### Monitoring

##### Lower operating expenses

Tigo gives you granular, module level monitoring with its Energy Intelligence Platform. Diagnose
anomalies at the module level, increase bankability, and lower maintenance expenses.
[Tigo safety icon red]

#### safety

##### Enhance safety and compliance

Tigo solutions meet US NEC Rapid Shutdown compliance and other safety codes that protect first
responders and are required in many countries.

## Simple, reliable installations

Tigo solutions can be applied to existing solar installations or new ones at virtually any scale.
Sites require just a few main components to unlock the benefits of optimization, advanced
module-level monitoring, and enhanced safety.

## Maximize the benefits of your solar

Whether you want to meet safety codes, monitor your site at the module level, or reduce the impacts
of shade, Tigo has you covered.
Only Tigo quantifies the benefits of module-level optimization by showing Reclaimed Energy in its
monitoring portal.
[Tigo optimization icon yellow]

#### Optimization

##### Increase energy output

Tigo Optimizers maximize energy output from your array and minimizes the losses from shade, module
mismatch, degradation, and other issues. The Tigo Reclaimed Energy feature validates and visualizes
optimizer benefits.
[Tigo monitoring icon blue]

#### Monitoring

##### Lower operating expenses

Tigo gives you granular, module level monitoring with its Energy Intelligence Platform. Diagnose
anomalies at the module level, increase bankability, and lower maintenance expenses.
[Tigo safety icon red]

#### safety

##### Enhance safety and compliance

Tigo solutions meet US NEC Rapid Shutdown compliance and other safety codes that protect first
responders and are required in many countries.

Tigo solutions can be applied to existing solar installations or new ones at virtually any scale.
Sites require just a few main components to unlock the benefits of optimization, advanced
module-level monitoring, and enhanced safety.

## Arbon SuperFactory

#### Intelligent Manufacturing

The Arbon SuperFactory is home to intelligent manufacturing of Solar PV Junction Boxes and the
application of advanced technologies to produce JBs that are compatible with a large variety of
solar module specifications.

#### Quality by Design

Our engineering team places a major emphasis on both process and equipment capabilities. Every
material going into the product is tested (internal QC as well as external third-party validation)
during the product design to ensure the highest quality standard and level of reliability.

#### Advancing Innovation

We pioneer in JB connectivity solutions that support demanding requirements of solar panel
efficiency and reliability, which are critical enablers for next-generation innovation across the
renewable energy industry. We have established strategic partnerships with some of the leading
players globally to strengthen our innovation efforts.

The Arbon SuperFactory is home to intelligent manufacturing of Solar PV Junction Boxes and the
application of advanced technologies to produce JBs that are compatible with a large variety of
solar module specifications.

#### Quality by Design

Our engineering team places a major emphasis on both process and equipment capabilities. Every
material going into the product is tested (internal QC as well as external third-party validation)
during the product design to ensure the highest quality standard and level of reliability.

#### Advancing Innovation

We pioneer in JB connectivity solutions that support demanding requirements of solar panel
efficiency and reliability, which are critical enablers for next-generation innovation across the
renewable energy industry. We have established strategic partnerships with some of the leading
players globally to strengthen our innovation efforts.

About Us

We, **Bhadra Enclosure Systems,** stepped in the industry in the year** 2017** itself are extremely
proud to inform that in a very short span of time we have gained a respectable position for
ourselves in the industry. Being a dependable** manufacturer, exporter and trader,** we understand
our responsibility and therefore, our entire focus is on developing quality products and then
delivering it on time. The comprehensive assortment of products that we deal in comprises **ABS
Enclosure, Junction Box, Cable Glands, Polycarbonate Enclosure, Aluminium Junction Box** and many
more.

As we comply with the stringent quality norms the engineering or fabrication of these enclosure
boxes are done as per the standard guidelines. Even the raw materials that are needed in the
manufacturing of the products are in compliance to the standard quality guidelines. We make complete
efforts to maintain such high quality of our products and at the same time we strive to meet with
the market demands within the stipulated time-period. Electrical and electronic industries are the
two sectors in which our products are needed and so accordingly the products are developed.

**Quality, A Crucial Factor**

Ever wondered why quality the most crucial factor for our organization? It is because quality helps
to develop trustworthy reputation in the market and also helps in attracting customers towards the
products. Unlike other firms, we start with the testing process as soon the raw materials are
received by us and is carried till the products are not shipped. We have our own quality management
facility in which the monitoring or inspection of the products is done. The laboratory has all the
requisite testing tools fitted in it with the help of which the testing operation is done.

**Our Logistic Support**

As soon the enclosures, junction box or any other product is manufactured in our factory and tested
the goods needs to be traded (distributed) in the market and for this logistics work we take
complete support of our logistics department. Our logistics team understand that the products need
to be distributed to the customers in their original state without getting damaged and so they store
them in strong packaging materials or carton boxes and then start with the shipment process. While
transporting the consignments they also make sure that:

* The team is keeping the track of the shipment
* The goods reaches in the promised time
* Exterior factors like weather does not damage the gamut

We, **Bhadra Enclosure Systems,** stepped in the industry in the year** 2017** itself are extremely

requisite testing tools fitted in it with the help of which the testing operation is done.

transporting the consignments they also make sure that:

BHB PV Solution is a solar PV junction box manufacturer in India operating out of Surat, Gujarat –
the country’s most active solar component manufacturing hub. Our components are not generic
catalogue parts. They are engineered for real-world thermal stress, consistent diode stability, and
long-term output reliability on both Indian and international project sites.

We work directly with solar panel manufacturers, EPC contractors, project developers, and
distributors who need a dependable Indian supplier – one they can call, trust, and scale with. Since
the day we started, every batch that has left our facility has gone through the same strict
production and quality standard. That consistency is not an accident. It is how we are built.

As a registered and patented solar junction box manufacturer in Surat, we hold ISO certification,
IEC compliance, RoHS certification, and Intellectual Property India recognition. These are not
trophies on a shelf – they are proof that our processes, materials, and output meet the standards
your project and your clients demand.

[ Learn About BHB ][25]

## The Component Everyone Ignores Until It Causes a System Failure.

Solar manufacturers spend months perfecting cell efficiency and module design. Then a substandard
junction box undoes all of it. The solar panel junction box is where current leaves your cells and
enters the world. It handles bypass diode switching under load, manages heat dissipation, and seals
every connection from moisture and contamination.

At BHB PV Solution, we have spent years studying why solar junction boxes fail in the field. Weak
conductor crimps. Diodes that drift under heat cycles. Enclosures that crack after two monsoon
seasons. We built our entire product design and manufacturing process around eliminating these exact
failure points.

Our split PV junction box design improves thermal separation between the diode chamber and connector
section which directly reduces heat buildup, extends diode lifespan, and keeps your modules
performing at rated output across the system’s entire operational life.

### Thermal Safety

Repeated heat cycles are the most common cause of junction box seal failure. Our enclosures are
tested across temperature extremes that mirror the worst conditions on Indian and Middle Eastern
project sites and they hold.

### Diode Stability

A single bypass diode that conducts when it should not, or fails to conduct when it must, cuts
string output significantly. We validate every diode before assembly. Not in sample batches every
unit.

### Field Durability

Dust accumulation, UV exposure, ground vibration, and monsoon moisture - none of these are lab
conditions, but they are all real. Our best quality solar junction box enclosures are built and
field-tested for exactly these environments.

## A Solar Junction Box Built to Handle What Your Project Actually Faces - Not Just What a Lab
## Simulates.

Global climates vary. Installation conditions are unpredictable. Our PV junction boxes are
engineered to perform regardless.

Solar manufacturers across India, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and Africa trust BHB PV Solution
because our components do not need to be babied. They go into modules, they go into the field, and
they keep working. The thermal management design ensures consistent diode performance whether your
project sits at 1,200 metres elevation or sea leve

No overcomplicated vendor portals. No 14-step approval chains. Just a clean process that respects

We start with a single focused conversation, your module type, frame design, batch volume, delivery

You receive a detailed, itemised quotation within 24 hours. Every cost is visible with materials,

Your batch enters our ISO-controlled production line. Five quality checkpoints cover sealing
integrity, conductor resistance, diode performance, fit-tolerance, and finish inspection. Nothing

We manufacture and dispatch from our Surat facility on the committed timeline. Domestic deliveries
across India are fast and trackable. Export shipments follow pre-agreed logistics plans no
last-minute scrambles.

After your first order, we maintain your specifications on file, monitor your reorder cycle, and
proactively notify you when stock needs to be planned. Consistent supply is not a promise – it is

string output significantly. We validate every diode before assembly. Not in sample batches every

### APIs

[Find out more][139]

We understand what is at stake in your API program and bring decades of experience in development
and manufacturing to ensure a reliable, high-quality drug substance supply that keeps your project
progressing with confidence.

Our API development & manufacturing capabilities include:
* [**Peptides**][140]
* [**PepCellerate™ FIH Peptide-Injectable Clinical Trial Supply**][141]
* [**Tag-Assisted Peptide Synthesis (TAPS)**][142]
* [**Oligonucleotides**][143]
* [**HPAPIs**][144]
* [**Small Molecules**][145]
* [**API Support Services**][146] (Flow Chemistry, Crystallization, Solid Forms,
  Polymorphism, Purification Services)

### Drug Products

[Find out more][147]

Our broad spectrum of drug product capabilities spans from clinical development through
commercialization across a wide range of dosage forms, including Oral Solid Dosage
(OSD), Aseptic Fill and Finish sterile injectables, and Oral Peptide Delivery, covering multiple
modalities, including highly potent compounds. With advanced packaging, labeling, and serialization
capabilities, we deliver reliable, high-quality drug product supply to support your program at every
stage. 

Our Drug Product development & manufacturing capabilities include:
* **Non-Sterile Dosage Forms**
  * [**Oral Solid Dose**][148]
  * [**Non-Sterile Liquids**][149]
  * [**Rectal Dosage Forms**][150]
* **Sterile Dosage Forms**
  * **[Aseptic Fill & Finish][151]  **
  * [**Sterile Liquids**][152]
  * [**Sterile Powder-Lyophilized Vials**][153]
* [**Drug Product Specialities**][154]
  * [**Bioavailability Enhancement**][155]
  * [**LNP Formulation Development & Manufacturing**][156]
  * [**Oral Peptide Delivery**][157]
* **Packaging**
  * [**Pharma Packaging Services**][158]

### Lipid Excipients & Nanomedicines

[Find out more][159]

We are a global CDMO leader in pioneering specialized lipid-based products, supporting the
development and manufacturing of nanomedicines with expertise in synthetic lipid process
development, LNP formulation, scale-up, and large-scale manufacturing. Our high-quality lipid
excipient building blocks, LNP starter kits, and cutting-edge technologies support your supply of
lipid-based medicines, no matter the scale or phase of development. 

Our Lipid Excipient and Nanomedicine capabilities include:
* [**LNP Formulation Development & Manufacturing**][160]
* [**LNP Starter Kits**][161]
* [**Custom Lipid Manufacturing**][162]
* [**Standard Lipids Catalog**][163]
* **[Lipid Excipient Technologies][164] **(ADME & DMPK, SORT-Coated LNPs)

### True End-to-End Supply

Managing multiple CDMOs across development stages and technologies increases coordination effort,
risk, and timelines. CordenPharma integrates development and manufacturing of complex modalities
across APIs, Drug Products and Packaging at all scales, coordinated through a global delivery and
project management model.

**What this means for you: **
* Fewer handovers between suppliers and project phases
* Clear accountability across development and manufacturing activities
* Better visibility and control from early development through commercial supply

### Lipid Excipients & Nanomedicines

We are a global CDMO leader in pioneering specialized lipid-based products, supporting the
development and manufacturing of nanomedicines with expertise in synthetic lipid process
development, LNP formulation, scale-up, and large-scale manufacturing. Our high-quality lipid
excipient building blocks, LNP starter kits, and cutting-edge technologies support your supply of
lipid-based medicines, no matter the scale or phase of development. 

Our Lipid Excipient and Nanomedicine capabilities include:

    [
    The use of valve plug pre-cast cables improves quick connections in the field. Since the precast
    cable has been configured with a plug matching the solenoid valve in advance, the connection can
    be completed by simply plugging and unplugging during installation, eliminating the need for
    tedious steps such as stripping and wiring on site, greatly saving installation time. In
    addition, the sealing performance of precast cables is better, which can effectively prevent
    impurities and moisture from entering the connecting parts, improving the stability and
    reliability of the equipment.
    ][172]
    [Cable][173]
    [
    Fuyansheng Electronics can provide a wide range of bulk cables of the same high quality as our
    prefabricated cables. This service allows our customers to purchase the required lengths when
    needed, packed in cable reels, with a minimum meter length of 100 metres.
    ][174]
    [Accessory][175]
    [
    Connectors and cable fixing brackets, plugs and marking sleeves play an important role in the
    connection and maintenance of electronic equipment. Reasonable selection and use of these
    accessories will help improve the stability and reliability of the equipment, and also
    facilitate the work of management and maintenance personnel. In the future development, with the
    continuous updating of electronic equipment and technological advancement, these accessories
    will continue to be improved and innovated to meet the increasingly complex device connection
    needs.

    integrated junction box, and manage the connection and management of the control system through
    a multi-core cable to facilitate management and line arrangement. In order to ensure a clear
    display of the equipment's operating status, the M8 junction box is equipped with an LED
    display, allowing users to obtain equipment operating data intuitively and quickly. We are
    convinced that this M8 distributor will become your first choice for equipment operation and
    maintenance. The integrated junction box can be produced with cables according to the length of
    on-site wiring. The cables have flexible and fixed installation options, and the length can also
    be customized as needed.。

    [Valve plug cable][171]
    [
    The use of valve plug pre-cast cables improves quick connections in the field. Since the precast
    cable has been configured with a plug matching the solenoid valve in advance, the connection can
    be completed by simply plugging and unplugging during installation, eliminating the need for
    tedious steps such as stripping and wiring on site, greatly saving installation time. In
    addition, the sealing performance of precast cables is better, which can effectively prevent
    impurities and moisture from entering the connecting parts, improving the stability and
    reliability of the equipment.
    ][172]
    [Cable][173]
    [
    Fuyansheng Electronics can provide a wide range of bulk cables of the same high quality as our
    prefabricated cables. This service allows our customers to purchase the required lengths when
    needed, packed in cable reels, with a minimum meter length of 100 metres.
    ][174]
    [Accessory][175]
    [
    Connectors and cable fixing brackets, plugs and marking sleeves play an important role in the
    connection and maintenance of electronic equipment. Reasonable selection and use of these
    accessories will help improve the stability and reliability of the equipment, and also
    facilitate the work of management and maintenance personnel. In the future development, with the
    continuous updating of electronic equipment and technological advancement, these accessories
    will continue to be improved and innovated to meet the increasingly complex device connection
    needs.
    ][176]
    [M8 signal junction box][177]
    [Integrated junction box][178]
    [
    The M8 junction box can integrate the scattered IO points of various devices into a unified
    integrated junction box, and manage the connection and management of the control system through
    a multi-core cable to facilitate management and line arrangement. In order to ensure a clear
    display of the equipment's operating status, the M8 junction box is equipped with an LED
    display, allowing users to obtain equipment operating data intuitively and quickly. We are
    convinced that this M8 distributor will become your first choice for equipment operation and
    maintenance. The integrated junction box can be produced with cables according to the length of
    on-site wiring. The cables have flexible and fixed installation options, and the length can also
    be customized as needed.。
    ][179]
    [Split junction box][180]
    [
    The M8 junction box can centralize the scattered IO points of various types of equipment and use
    multi-core cables for connection management of the control system, which facilitates management
    and line arrangement. In order to clearly display the operating status of the equipment, the M8
    junction box is equipped with an LED display so that users can quickly obtain equipment
    operating data. We believe that this M8 dispenser will become your first choice for equipment
    operation and maintenance. The split junction box can be separated from the integrated
    multi-core cable according to the on-site wiring environment or the need for quick component
    replacement, and the signal connection is realized through docking and locking.。

## Find a Location

Greentech Renewables is a leading name in solar distribution. We are local nationwide, with over 100
locations** **in major solar markets. We are dedicated to supporting your business with unmatched
service and a diverse selection of vetted products for residential and commercial projects. 

## What Our Customers Are Saying

[22.2 kW residential solar panel installation in North Bennington.]

> Installing the solar system on this tile roof was more complicated and time-consuming than on
> asphalt shingle roofs. We counted on Greentech Renewables' expertise, detailed engineering plans,
> and guidance on the right type of roof applications for the successful completion of this five-day
> installation. The homeowner was satisfied with the installation and looked forward to energy
> savings with his new solar system!

> The Greentech Renewables Team helped us at each stage to connect with vendors, specify equipment
> that worked for us, and solve the supply chain issues to keep the project on schedule. They paid
> attention to details, so we weren’t short of materials in the field and finished the installation
> a week ahead of plan.

> Combining classic architecture with new technology creates a number of challenges, structurally,
> electrically, and aesthetically. Greentech Renewables balanced the needs and input of the
> community to bring the design and equipment forward.

> This project was unique because we combined roof mounting with a ballast-mounted solar system to
> accommodate the required number of panels for reducing electrical consumption in Pittsburgh.
> Throughout the process, Greentech Renewable was consistently available and collaborated with us to
> find the best solutions for the two different solar arrays.

> Having strong support and clear communication with individuals like Thomas from Greentech
> Renewables helped us navigate the various challenges associated with large-scale development.
> Collaborating with a reliable partner like Greentech Renewables allowed us, as developers, to
> concentrate on the construction and integration of the system rather than having to procure the
> necessary materials and components independently.

> We've been working with Greentech for 7 years now. In that time, they've truly become an extension
> of our team. Seth and Kelly, along with the rest of the Greentech team, are always quick to
> respond, easy to work with, and genuinely care about helping us succeed. In an industry that moves
> as fast as solar, having a team like that in your corner makes all the difference. At Southern
> Energy Management, we take pride in the relationships we build, and our partnership with Greentech
> is one we truly value.

## Services Beyond Supply

***Our commitment to service goes beyond supply; we empower and educate our customers. **Our
comprehensive design, finance, and commercial services are tailored to equip customers with the
essential tools and resources to efficiently and cost-effectively sell and install solar and energy
storage solutions. *

## Empowering Energy

HIS ist Ihr verlässlicher Partner für steckfertige Verkabelung, effiziente Verschaltung und
intelligente Energiemanagementsysteme. Wir entwickeln maßgeschneiderte Lösungen, die Ihr Projekt
nachhaltig voranbringen – von der ersten Planung bis zur sicheren Umsetzung. Wo sich unsere
Expertise mit Ihren Zielen verbindet, entsteht die Energie der Zukunft.

## Verlässliche Systeme, intelligente Lösungen

Als verlässlicher, proaktiver Partner entwickeln wir Komplettlösungen, die passgenau auf Ihre
Anforderungen zugeschnitten sind. So entstehen flexible Strategien mit dem Fokus auf maximale
Effizienz und termingerechte Umsetzung – die nachhaltige Verbindung zu Ihren Projektzielen.

[Expertise][11]
Unsere Kunden und Partner

## Plug-and-Play für jede Anlagengröße

### Residential

Optimierte Lösungen für private Solaranlagen: Als Partner des Fachhandwerks bieten wir hochwertige,
installationsfertige Komponenten für eine reibungslose Montage.

### Commercial & Industrial

### Utility

### Floating PV

## Gute Verbindungen – starke Energieprojekte

[Alle Beiträge ansehen][12]
Fachbeitrag

Vorkonfektionierte Kabelbäume vs. Vor-Ort-Konfektionierung

Zeit ist Geld – diese alte Weisheit gilt besonders bei der Installation von Solarkraftwerken. Die
Verkabelung stellt dabei einen kritischen Kostenfaktor dar, der oft unterschätzt wird. Doch genau
hier liegt erhebliches Einsparpotenzial: Bis zu 20% der Gesamtkosten lassen sich durch den Einsatz
vorkonfektionierter Kabelbäume einsparen. Wie ist das möglich?

Mehr erfahren
Fachbeitrag

Multi-Use-Szenarien für Energiemanagementsysteme

Die Zeiten einfacher Anwendungsszenarien in der Energiewirtschaft sind vorbei. Moderne
Energiemanagementsysteme (EMS) entwickeln sich zu multifunktionalen Schaltzentralen, die
verschiedene Anwendungen intelligent kombinieren. Eine Entwicklung, die nicht nur technisch
fasziniert, sondern auch wirtschaftlich überzeugt.

Mehr erfahren

### Ihr Partner für Energieprojekte

Mit zwei Jahrzehnten Erfahrung und einem verantwortungsbewussten Blick auf Zukunftstechnologien
gestalten wir weltweit Energielösungen, die bereits heute mehr als 40 GW Leistung erzeugen. Über
2000 Kunden in 60 Ländern vertrauen uns als Partner für maßgeschneiderte Energieinfrastrukturen.

* [[Drawer Slides]][113]
  
  #### [Drawer Slides][114]
  
  Xiamen Hongyu Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. is a factory and manufacturer specializing in the
  production of drawer slides, hinges, bed hinges, corner brackets, and more. Our cabinet drawer
  slides are renowned for their superior quality and craftsmanship. We specialize in innovative
  development and custom manufacturing, supporting customized production tailored to individual
  customer needs. HY currently utilizes automated stamping, welding, and painting processes,
  ensuring stable and reliable craftsmanship and quality while guaranteeing production efficiency.
  Our products are trusted by customers in Europe, America, Russia, the Middle East, and other

  filters, pipes, valves, connectors and other related accessories. HY focuses on developing new
  products. We can also provide OEM services according to customer drawings.
  Material: brass, aluminum alloy, zinc alloy, magnesium alloy
  Customized service: support
  Diameter: 1/2, 3/4, 1 inch

  the production of motor housing. From design to mold sample production, HY currently serves more
  than 50 industries, including automotive parts, consumer electronics, hardware tools, smart home
  and other industries.

  Surface treatment: anodizing, sandblasting, support customization
  Drawing format: AutoCAD, Solidworks, CAXA, UG, CAD

  support the production and customization of metal phone cases. You can provide samples or drawings
  of metal phone cases. HY has professional mechanical processing and system testing service
  processes. HY has a complete production line to ensure that it can meet the monthly production
  capacity needs and provide one-stop services, covering furniture accessories, electronic
  accessories, medical equipment accessories and other fields. HY is confident to establish
  long-term cooperation to provide customers with competitive solutions.
  ODM service time: It can be completed in 3-5 days at the fastest.
  Drawing design service: Support customized design service.
  Quality certificate: ISO 9001, ISO14001, REACH, RoHs
  Tolerance: 0.02
* [[photovoltaic inverter]][121]
  
  #### [photovoltaic inverter][122]
  
  Xiamen Hongyu Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. is a professional stamping manufacturer
  specializing in photovoltaic inverters. Our products are suitable for residential, commercial, and

  Xiamen Hongyu Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. is a professional manufacturer of stamped lunch

  Material: 304/316 food grade stainless steel

Shanghai Jome Industrial Co., Ltd. is a professional manufacturer and seller of industrial
adhesives, providing epoxy, silicone, polyurethane potting adhesives, thermal conductive materials,

## About Us

Kexun Electric Co., Ltd.

[**Kexun Electric Co., Ltd.**][91] is located in Yueqing City, Zhejiang Province, the well-known
"Electrical Capital of China", with the East China Sea and the Oujiang River in the south and
Yandang Mountain, a national scenic spot, in the north. The company was founded in 2010 with a
registered capital of 150 million yuan.

The company is a scientific and technological enterprise specializing in the research, production,
sales and service of power transmission and transformation equipment of 35KV and below. The main
products are: high-voltage inflatable cabinets, high voltage ring main unit, [**cable branch
box,**][92] cable distribution boxes, [**box-type substations**][93], power transformers,
high-voltage and low-voltage switchgear, SF6 ring main unit, central cabinets, meter boxes, SF6
high-voltage load switches, high-voltage components and so on.

### [GN19 Type Indoor HV Disconnector][95]

GN19 Type Indoor HV Disconnector, which is specially produced by Kexun in China Factory, is used
together with CS6-1 type human operating mechanism under the condition of voltage and no load, and
is often used as an on-off circuit in power systems with rated voltage of 12KV and alternating
current below 50Hz.

[[Pre-installed American Box Type Cabinet]][96]

### [Pre-installed American Box Type Cabinet][97]

Kexun is a power transmission and transformation equipment factory in China. Its beauty
Pre-installed American Box Type Cabinet is well known for its good protective performance, high
standardization, simple maintenance and wide applicability.
Model: ZBW-12

[[Pre-installed American Box Transformer]][98]

### [Pre-installed American Box Transformer][99]

Kexun is a supplier of high-quality Pre-installed American Box Transformer in China. Its products

## Applications

LINKWELL ELECTRIC for a variety of industries to provide comprehensive quality solutions.The
products are widely used in wind power, photovoltaic, energy storage applications, power and
electricity, charging piles, automation robots, infrastructure, high-tech industries and other
related fields.

[Wind power generation]

### Wind Power Generation

LINKWELL’s thermostats, heaters, and terminal blocks ensure reliability in wind farms’ harsh
environments. Our IP65-rated ventilation systems prevent dust ingress, while corrosion-resistant
wiring ducts maintain stable connections. Designed for extreme temperatures (-40°C to 85°C), these
components minimize downtime, supporting continuous operation in remote, high-vibration
installations.

[Photovoltaic power generation]

### Photovoltaic Power Generation

For solar energy systems, LINKWELL provides control transformers and junction boxes with high UV
resistance. Our low-loss transformers optimize DC/AC conversion efficiency, and flame-retardant
terminal blocks ensure safe, durable connections in inverters and combiner boxes, even under
prolonged sunlight exposure.

[Energy storage]

### Energy Storage

LINKWELL’s modular terminal blocks and heat-resistant wiring ducts streamline battery management
systems (BMS). Customizable transformers enable precise voltage regulation, while compact
ventilation fans prevent overheating in confined energy storage cabinets, enhancing safety and
scalability for grid-scale solutions.

[Electric power]

### Electric Power

From substations to smart grids, LINKWELL’s HV/LV control transformers and panel heaters ensure
stable power distribution. Anti-arc terminal blocks reduce short-circuit risks, and high-strength
wiring ducts organize cabling in switchgear, meeting IEC standards for reliability in critical
infrastructure projects.

[Charging Pile]

### Charging Pile

LINKWELL equips EV charging stations with shockproof terminal blocks, waterproof ventilation fans,
and surge-protected control transformers. Our solutions withstand frequent plugging cycles and
outdoor weather fluctuations, ensuring 24/7 operational stability and compliance with global EV
charging safety protocols.

[High tech]

### High-tech

LINKWELL ELECTRIC provides advanced electrical products tailored for high-tech applications,
ensuring precision, reliability, and seamless integration with sophisticated systems. Our solutions
empower industries such as semiconductors, AI, and IoT, supporting the rapid development of
technology with superior performance and durability.

[Infrastructure]

### Infrastructure

LINKWELL ELECTRIC delivers high-quality products designed for urban construction, transportation
networks, and smart city projects. With a focus on resilience and adaptability, our solutions
enhance the reliability of critical infrastructure, contributing to the sustainable development of
communities worldwide.

[Automated Robot]

### Automated Robot

Automation and robotics are transforming industries by improving productivity and precision. We
supplies high-performance electrical components that meet the rigorous demands of automated robots,
enabling seamless operation in manufacturing, logistics, and beyond. Our products enhance
efficiency, reduce downtime, and support the advancement of intelligent automation systems.

Enclosure air conditioner application scenarios?

Enclosure air conditioners are widely used in electrical control cabinets, telecom equipment, CNC
machines, and power distribution boxes. They ensure stable internal temperatures in high-heat
environments, protecting sensitive electronics from overheating, dust, and humidity. Our factory
designs enclosure cooling systems suitable for industrial automation, data centers, and outdoor
cabinets, where continuous and reliable thermal management is critical for performance and equipment
lifespan.

How to select a fan for an enclosure?

Choosing the right enclosure fan depends on cabinet size, heat load, airflow requirements, and
environmental conditions. We recommend considering IP protection ratings, noise level, and energy
efficiency. At our factory, we produce high-performance cooling fans engineered to maintain stable
airflow while extending component life. For harsh or dusty environments, we advise pairing fans with
filters or thermostats for better control and protection.

What are UL-certified products?

UL-certified products meet Underwriters Laboratories (UL) safety standards, recognized globally. For
cabinet components, UL certification ensures fire resistance, electrical safety, and durability. As
a factory, we provide UL-compliant cooling fans, heaters, transformers, and lighting solutions,
giving customers confidence that our products meet international quality and safety requirements.
UL-certified parts are especially important for projects in North America and other regions
requiring strict compliance.

## Applications

LINKWELL ELECTRIC for a variety of industries to provide comprehensive quality solutions.The
products are widely used in wind power, photovoltaic, energy storage applications, power and
electricity, charging piles, automation robots, infrastructure, high-tech industries and other
related fields.

[Wind power generation]

### Wind Power Generation

LINKWELL’s thermostats, heaters, and terminal blocks ensure reliability in wind farms’ harsh
environments. Our IP65-rated ventilation systems prevent dust ingress, while corrosion-resistant
wiring ducts maintain stable connections. Designed for extreme temperatures (-40°C to 85°C), these
components minimize downtime, supporting continuous operation in remote, high-vibration
installations.

[Photovoltaic power generation]

### Photovoltaic Power Generation

For solar energy systems, LINKWELL provides control transformers and junction boxes with high UV
resistance. Our low-loss transformers optimize DC/AC conversion efficiency, and flame-retardant
terminal blocks ensure safe, durable connections in inverters and combiner boxes, even under
prolonged sunlight exposure.

[Energy storage]

### Energy Storage

LINKWELL’s modular terminal blocks and heat-resistant wiring ducts streamline battery management
systems (BMS). Customizable transformers enable precise voltage regulation, while compact
ventilation fans prevent overheating in confined energy storage cabinets, enhancing safety and
scalability for grid-scale solutions.

[Electric power]

### Electric Power

From substations to smart grids, LINKWELL’s HV/LV control transformers and panel heaters ensure
stable power distribution. Anti-arc terminal blocks reduce short-circuit risks, and high-strength
wiring ducts organize cabling in switchgear, meeting IEC standards for reliability in critical
infrastructure projects.

[Charging Pile]

### Charging Pile

LINKWELL equips EV charging stations with shockproof terminal blocks, waterproof ventilation fans,
and surge-protected control transformers. Our solutions withstand frequent plugging cycles and
outdoor weather fluctuations, ensuring 24/7 operational stability and compliance with global EV
charging safety protocols.

[High tech]

### High-tech

LINKWELL ELECTRIC provides advanced electrical products tailored for high-tech applications,
ensuring precision, reliability, and seamless integration with sophisticated systems. Our solutions
empower industries such as semiconductors, AI, and IoT, supporting the rapid development of
technology with superior performance and durability.

[Infrastructure]

### Infrastructure

LINKWELL ELECTRIC delivers high-quality products designed for urban construction, transportation
networks, and smart city projects. With a focus on resilience and adaptability, our solutions
enhance the reliability of critical infrastructure, contributing to the sustainable development of
communities worldwide.

[Automated Robot]

### Automated Robot

Automation and robotics are transforming industries by improving productivity and precision. We
supplies high-performance electrical components that meet the rigorous demands of automated robots,
enabling seamless operation in manufacturing, logistics, and beyond. Our products enhance
efficiency, reduce downtime, and support the advancement of intelligent automation systems.

Enclosure air conditioner application scenarios?

Enclosure air conditioners are widely used in electrical control cabinets, telecom equipment, CNC
machines, and power distribution boxes. They ensure stable internal temperatures in high-heat
environments, protecting sensitive electronics from overheating, dust, and humidity. Our factory
designs enclosure cooling systems suitable for industrial automation, data centers, and outdoor
cabinets, where continuous and reliable thermal management is critical for performance and equipment
lifespan.

How to select a fan for an enclosure?

Choosing the right enclosure fan depends on cabinet size, heat load, airflow requirements, and
environmental conditions. We recommend considering IP protection ratings, noise level, and energy
efficiency. At our factory, we produce high-performance cooling fans engineered to maintain stable
airflow while extending component life. For harsh or dusty environments, we advise pairing fans with
filters or thermostats for better control and protection.

What are UL-certified products?

UL-certified products meet Underwriters Laboratories (UL) safety standards, recognized globally. For
cabinet components, UL certification ensures fire resistance, electrical safety, and durability. As

giving customers confidence that our products meet international quality and safety requirements.
UL-certified parts are especially important for projects in North America and other regions
requiring strict compliance.

Reliable powertrain, sustainable future.
[ Learn More — Reliable powertrain, sustainable future. ][27]
EV Charging Cable with Connector – Type 2 Mode 3 – AC
EV charging cable and Type 2 Mode 3 connector we have developed for electric vehicle charging
systems have been entirely designed by our in-house R&D and engineering team. They are certified and
manufactured in accordance with international standards. This product has been developed to meet
high performance, safety, and durability criteria.
[ Learn More — EV Charging Cable with Connector – Type 2 Mode 3 – AC ][28]
EN50620 - IEC62893 EV Charging Cable - AC
Our cables for electric vehicle charging systems are certified and manufactured in accordance with
international standards. This product was developed to meet high performance, safety, and durability
criteria.
[ Learn More — EN50620 - IEC62893 EV Charging Cable - AC ][29]
FLRY A&B Cables
Our FLRY-A and FLRY-B cables are certified and manufactured in accordance with international
standards. They offer high performance, flexibility, and durability, providing a safe solution for
automotive applications.
[ Learn More — FLRY A&B Cables ][30]
PV Junction Box (for Solar Panels)
The PV Solar Junction Box is used in solar projects to securely connect the panel to the solar
cables. It is manufactured in accordance with international standards, and the certification process
is currently ongoing. With its resistance to dust, moisture, heat, and UV rays, it provides a
durable and reliable connection solution even in harsh environmental conditions.
[ Learn More — PV Junction Box (for Solar Panels) ][31]
PV Solar Cables
Our solar cables are specially developed for solar energy systems and are highly resistant to harsh
outdoor conditions. They are designed to withstand temperatures ranging from -40°C to +90°C.
Certified and manufactured in accordance with international standards, our solar cables ensure
long-lasting, reliable energy transmission with minimal power loss.
[ Learn More — PV Solar Cables ][32]

EV Charging Cable with Connector – Type 2 Mode 3 – AC
EV charging cable and Type 2 Mode 3 connector we have developed for electric vehicle charging
systems have been entirely designed by our in-house R&D and engineering team. They are certified and
manufactured in accordance with international standards. This product has been developed to meet
high performance, safety, and durability criteria.
[ Learn More — EV Charging Cable with Connector – Type 2 Mode 3 – AC ][28]
EN50620 - IEC62893 EV Charging Cable - AC
Our cables for electric vehicle charging systems are certified and manufactured in accordance with
international standards. This product was developed to meet high performance, safety, and durability
criteria.
[ Learn More — EN50620 - IEC62893 EV Charging Cable - AC ][29]
FLRY A&B Cables
Our FLRY-A and FLRY-B cables are certified and manufactured in accordance with international
standards. They offer high performance, flexibility, and durability, providing a safe solution for
automotive applications.
[ Learn More — FLRY A&B Cables ][30]
PV Junction Box (for Solar Panels)
The PV Solar Junction Box is used in solar projects to securely connect the panel to the solar
cables. It is manufactured in accordance with international standards, and the certification process
is currently ongoing. With its resistance to dust, moisture, heat, and UV rays, it provides a
durable and reliable connection solution even in harsh environmental conditions.
[ Learn More — PV Junction Box (for Solar Panels) ][31]
PV Solar Cables
Our solar cables are specially developed for solar energy systems and are highly resistant to harsh
outdoor conditions. They are designed to withstand temperatures ranging from -40°C to +90°C.
Certified and manufactured in accordance with international standards, our solar cables ensure
long-lasting, reliable energy transmission with minimal power loss.
[ Learn More — PV Solar Cables ][32]

* ## [Metal Distribution Box][182]
  
  Metal distribution boxes are primarily utilized to safeguard the circuits and switch control
  components within electrical systems. The robust metal structure of this series of products can
  withstand external physical impacts and a certain level of outdoor environmental interference,
  thereby effectively ensuring the long - term stable operation of the electrical equipment inside
  the products. This series of products can fulfill the diverse indoor and outdoor power
  distribution installation requirements in industrial zones, commercial areas, residential areas,
  and other locations.
  
  
  
  ## Stainless steel and cold-rolled steel plates: How to Choose Materials?
  
  When selecting products from this series, it is advisable to prioritize the choice of materials
  based on the performance or application scenarios of the required products.
  
  1. The [**Stainless Steel Distribution Box**][183] is fabricated from high - quality 304, 316, or
  201 stainless steel, which exhibits excellent corrosion resistance and can effectively prevent
  rust in a humid environment. After being brushed or polished, the product's surface appears
  aesthetically pleasing and is easy to clean. Stainless - steel distribution boxes are especially
  suitable for environments with high hygiene standards, such as the food, chemical, and
  pharmaceutical industries, and are also applicable to outdoor damp or dusty situations.
  
  2. The [**Iron Distribution Box**][184] is made of high - quality cold - rolled steel plate and
  undergoes processes such as acid washing, phosphating, and electrostatic powder coating. These
  processes can guarantee the protective performance and high - strength structure of the product,
  and the cost is competitive. The product has a smooth appearance, and the color can be customized.
  It is applicable to indoor industrial plants, equipment rooms, building electrical shafts, and
  distribution rooms.
  
  
  
  ## Key parameters: The protection grade (IP) and installation method of metal distribution boxes
  
  When choosing the required distribution box, in addition to the material, the following choices
  should also be noted:
  
  ●Protection grade (IP code) : For example, IP54 (dust-proof, splash-proof), IP65 (dust-tight,
  water-proof). This factor determines whether the product box can be used in outdoor, dusty or
  humid environments.
  
  ●Installation methods: Mainly divided into exposed installation (wall-mounted, vertical pole) and
  concealed installation (embedded in the wall). The appropriate installation method should be
  selected based on the installation environment.
  
  During the procurement process, customers often prioritize the balance between product durability
  and acquisition cost. Additionally, they frequently evaluate whether the installation method
  offers sufficient flexibility and whether the protection rating meets the requirements of specific
  operating environments.
  
  
  
  ## As a manufacturer and supplier in China, what can we offer?
  
  As a supplier with extensive expertise in the metal distribution boxes industry, we fully
  recognize the importance customers place on these factors. Accordingly, while offering standard
  specification products, we also provide customized solutions through our Manufacturer in China,
  tailored to meet specific client needs such as installation configurations, inlet and outlet
  wiring arrangements, internal layout design, and product color options.
  
  
  
  [View More +][185]
  [[Metal Distribution Box]][186]
* ## [Metal Cabinet][187]
  
  Metal cabinets are suitable for protecting precision electronic equipment, control units, etc. The
  core value lies in creating a stable operating environment for the internal core electrical
  equipment.
  
  
  
  ## The core difference: Stainless steel cabinets and steel (cold-rolled steel) cabinets
  
  ●[**Stainless steel cabinet**][188]: With 304 or 316 stainless steel (201 is optional) as the core
  material. The advantage lies in the corrosion resistance of this material, which can resist the
  erosion of water, chemical media and salt spray. It is suitable for highly corrosive environments
  (such as chemical plants, coastal areas, food and pharmaceutical industries, and high-frequency
  cleaning sites).
  
  ●[**Iron cabinet**][189]: Made of high-strength, high-quality cold-rolled steel plate, and treated
  with surface electrostatic powder coating, this process builds a firm protective coating on the
  surface of the plate, which is sufficient to cope with the vast majority of conventional indoor
  industrial environments, data centers, offices, communication rooms and other usage environments.
  
  
  
  ## How to reflect the specific differences between the two cabinets?
  
  ●Process and appearance: stainless steel cabinet surface often do drawing or mirror processing, so
  that you can highlight the metal color texture; Iron cabinet will provide a variety of spray
  colors (such as black, white, gray, etc.), the appearance of the choice is more flexible, can be
  selected according to the actual needs.
  
  
  
  ## As a manufacturer and supplier in China, what metal cabinets can we provide?
  
  We are a professional factory in China, integrating R&D, production and sales. As a reliable
  supplier, we provide a full range of conventional specifications and custom metal cabinets.

  the products. This series of products can fulfill the diverse indoor and outdoor power
  distribution installation requirements in industrial zones, commercial areas, residential areas,
  and other locations.
  
  
  
  ## Stainless steel and cold-rolled steel plates: How to Choose Materials?
  
  When selecting products from this series, it is advisable to prioritize the choice of materials
  based on the performance or application scenarios of the required products.
  
  1. The [**Stainless Steel Distribution Box**][183] is fabricated from high - quality 304, 316, or
  201 stainless steel, which exhibits excellent corrosion resistance and can effectively prevent
  rust in a humid environment. After being brushed or polished, the product's surface appears
  aesthetically pleasing and is easy to clean. Stainless - steel distribution boxes are especially
  suitable for environments with high hygiene standards, such as the food, chemical, and
  pharmaceutical industries, and are also applicable to outdoor damp or dusty situations.
  
  2. The [**Iron Distribution Box**][184] is made of high - quality cold - rolled steel plate and
  undergoes processes such as acid washing, phosphating, and electrostatic powder coating. These
  processes can guarantee the protective performance and high - strength structure of the product,
  and the cost is competitive. The product has a smooth appearance, and the color can be customized.
  It is applicable to indoor industrial plants, equipment rooms, building electrical shafts, and
  distribution rooms.
  
  
  
  ## Key parameters: The protection grade (IP) and installation method of metal distribution boxes
  
  When choosing the required distribution box, in addition to the material, the following choices
  should also be noted:
  
  ●Protection grade (IP code) : For example, IP54 (dust-proof, splash-proof), IP65 (dust-tight,
  water-proof). This factor determines whether the product box can be used in outdoor, dusty or
  humid environments.
  
  ●Installation methods: Mainly divided into exposed installation (wall-mounted, vertical pole) and
  concealed installation (embedded in the wall). The appropriate installation method should be
  selected based on the installation environment.
  
  During the procurement process, customers often prioritize the balance between product durability
  and acquisition cost. Additionally, they frequently evaluate whether the installation method
  offers sufficient flexibility and whether the protection rating meets the requirements of specific
  operating environments.
  
  
  
  ## As a manufacturer and supplier in China, what can we offer?
  
  As a supplier with extensive expertise in the metal distribution boxes industry, we fully
  recognize the importance customers place on these factors. Accordingly, while offering standard
  specification products, we also provide customized solutions through our Manufacturer in China,
  tailored to meet specific client needs such as installation configurations, inlet and outlet
  wiring arrangements, internal layout design, and product color options.

* ## [Metal Cabinet][187]
  
  Metal cabinets are suitable for protecting precision electronic equipment, control units, etc. The
  core value lies in creating a stable operating environment for the internal core electrical
  equipment.
  
  
  
  ## The core difference: Stainless steel cabinets and steel (cold-rolled steel) cabinets
  
  ●[**Stainless steel cabinet**][188]: With 304 or 316 stainless steel (201 is optional) as the core
  material. The advantage lies in the corrosion resistance of this material, which can resist the
  erosion of water, chemical media and salt spray. It is suitable for highly corrosive environments
  (such as chemical plants, coastal areas, food and pharmaceutical industries, and high-frequency
  cleaning sites).
  
  ●[**Iron cabinet**][189]: Made of high-strength, high-quality cold-rolled steel plate, and treated
  with surface electrostatic powder coating, this process builds a firm protective coating on the
  surface of the plate, which is sufficient to cope with the vast majority of conventional indoor
  industrial environments, data centers, offices, communication rooms and other usage environments.
  
  
  
  ## How to reflect the specific differences between the two cabinets?
  
  ●Process and appearance: stainless steel cabinet surface often do drawing or mirror processing, so
  that you can highlight the metal color texture; Iron cabinet will provide a variety of spray
  colors (such as black, white, gray, etc.), the appearance of the choice is more flexible, can be
  selected according to the actual needs.
  
  
  
  ## As a manufacturer and supplier in China, what metal cabinets can we provide?
  
  We are a professional factory in China, integrating R&D, production and sales. As a reliable

### Company Profile

Established in 1948 by George “Monty” Pratley, the Pratley stable of companies rests on a foundation
of research and innovation. Drawing from 75 years of experience, Pratley has filed more than 350
patents worldwide and is involved in the manufacturing and marketing of brand leading electrical
cable termination products to global markets. View Pratley’s History.

Pratley Head Office & Manufacturing Facility - Johannesburg, South Africa

With expertise of over 200 employees, we pride ourselves in the production of highly innovative
electrical cable glands, electrical junction boxes and related accessories. Those variants for use
in hazardous locations comply with international IECEx Standards for Ex n, Ex e and Ex d explosion
protected equipment. Many Pratley cable glands and boxes also comply with the European ATEX
directive.

Modern Manufacturing Capabilities

Pratley products can be found in many international mines, petrochemical plants and collieries
including those of Sasol, Chevron, Natref, Anglo Platinum, Anglo Gold, Mosgas Offshore, AECI, De
Beers, Exxaro, Amcoal and many more. Our market leading electrical products serve the industrial,
mining, construction, petrochemical and consumer markets in many countries around the globe. Pratley
manufactures over 800 products, has filed more than 350 patents world-wide and is an ISO 9001:2015
accredited organisation.

# The History of the Pratley

Johannesburg on 19 September 1917 and educated at King Edward School and Wits University. After the
death of his father, he used a small inheritance to study at Rugby College of Technology and Arts in
England.

When war was declared in 1939 he intended to join the British Army, but as he was employed by the
British Thomson Houston Company of Whittle Jet Engine fame, an essential industry as far as the war
effort was concerned, this company would not release him. He was eventually released in 1942 and
joined the 7th Armoured Division in time to take part in the D-Day landings in Normandy.

After the war had ended, he was repatriated to South Africa in 1946 and was employed for two years
at the Durban Deep Gold Mine on the Reef before starting his own business.

death of his father, he used a small inheritance to study at Rugby College of Technology and Arts in
England.

British Thomson Houston Company of Whittle Jet Engine fame, an essential industry as far as the war
effort was concerned, this company would not release him. He was eventually released in 1942 and
joined the 7th Armoured Division in time to take part in the D-Day landings in Normandy.

After the war had ended, he was repatriated to South Africa in 1946 and was employed for two years
at the Durban Deep Gold Mine on the Reef before starting his own business.

## The Best PV Junction Boxes for Professional Installers

### **SolaDeck 0399 Universal Rail Mount – Samples Now Available!**

Email us at [sales@soladeck.com][11] for additional info and free samples

### Labor-Saving, Fast Installation

Knockouts in sidewalls eliminate drilling. Slotted cover secured with one pre-installed set screw.

### Premium Quality

Crafted from American-sourced steel, SolaDecks are stamped, powder coated, and assembled in
Wisconsin. They are UL1741 certified and meet Type 3R standards.

### Guaranteed Not To Leak

The original V-shaped design is specifically engineered to ensure proper water drainage and runoff.
Weep holes in the base allow moisture, caused by condensation, to safely escape from the box.
Flashing into two layers of shingle course ensures proper water shedding.

### Maximum Safety & Security

Steel boxes offer superior fire protection, and the durability of powder-coated steel provides
long-term peace of mind.

## The SolaDeck Product Line

There are Five SolaDeck product lines to choose from based on the type of roof and the voltage of
your project.

Our boxes are compatible with industry standard bus bars, fuse blocks, and rail mount components.
Full details are available in the [installation manual][12].

[][13]

### **NOW AVAILABLE**

### SolaDeck 0399

Universal Rail Box for systems rated to 1000V

[][14]

For asphalt or cedar roofs with systems rated to 600V

[][15]

### SolaDeck 0799

For asphalt or cedar roofs with systems rated to 600V

[][16]

### SolaDeck 0766

For deep tile or slate roofs with systems rated to 600V

[][17]

### SolaDeck 0999

For asphalt or cedar roofs with systems rated to 1000V

## Our Job Is To Make Your Job Easier

The SolaDeck isn’t just the most durable box on the market – it’s been extensively researched and
designed to make your installs easy and hassle-free.

### Fast, Effective, Consistent Installs

Using a SolaDeck junction box gives you a quick, streamlined procedure for connecting your PV
junction equipment. It’s faster, easier, more secure, and it looks great!

### Flashed PV Enclosure

The SolaDeck provides a ridged flashing that easily slides into your roof system. This provides a
secure, weatherproof penetration on your roof for your PV wiring while eliminating the worry of
future roof damage.

### Go Greener with SolaDeck

Take your eco friendly project one step greener! Did you know that 80% of metal is recycled and can
be recycled indefinitely? Currently, per Consumer Reports only 8% of plastic is recycled and can
only be recycled one time! Click [here][18] for additional info!

## The Details Make The Difference

When designing our junction box, we insisted on getting it right. We applied our own deep experience
as contractors, and collaborated with roofers, satellite / solar installers, HVAC installers, and
other professionals who understand what both time and the elements do to outdoor roof-mounted
equipment. And the result is the SolaDeck.

### Powder-Coated Steel, Not Plastic

A SolaDeck will withstand cold from cracking, heat from melting, and the ravages of nature including
hail, tree debris, or storm damage. In the event of a catastrophic system failure that results in a
fire inside the box, the SolaDeck can keep it contained.

### Tested Extensively

Our units live outside. That is why we have tested them for exposure to the blazing sun, the
freezing cold, the harsh sea air of maritime climates, and everything in between. We test them above
and beyond anything they’ll ever experience, so they will perform above and beyond your
expectations.

### Built To Last

Each and every SolaDeck – from steel coil to finished product – is made in the USA by craftsmen that
take pride in their work. We don’t cut corners, and we stand behind every SolaDeck we sell. That’s
probably why there are units from 20+ years ago that are still in the field and going strong!

designed to make your installs easy and hassle-free.

### Fast, Effective, Consistent Installs

Using a SolaDeck junction box gives you a quick, streamlined procedure for connecting your PV
junction equipment. It’s faster, easier, more secure, and it looks great!

### Flashed PV Enclosure

The SolaDeck provides a ridged flashing that easily slides into your roof system. This provides a
secure, weatherproof penetration on your roof for your PV wiring while eliminating the worry of
future roof damage.

### Go Greener with SolaDeck

Take your eco friendly project one step greener! Did you know that 80% of metal is recycled and can
be recycled indefinitely? Currently, per Consumer Reports only 8% of plastic is recycled and can
only be recycled one time! Click [here][18] for additional info!

## The Details Make The Difference

When designing our junction box, we insisted on getting it right. We applied our own deep experience
as contractors, and collaborated with roofers, satellite / solar installers, HVAC installers, and
other professionals who understand what both time and the elements do to outdoor roof-mounted
equipment. And the result is the SolaDeck.

### Powder-Coated Steel, Not Plastic

A SolaDeck will withstand cold from cracking, heat from melting, and the ravages of nature including
hail, tree debris, or storm damage. In the event of a catastrophic system failure that results in a
fire inside the box, the SolaDeck can keep it contained.

### Tested Extensively

Our units live outside. That is why we have tested them for exposure to the blazing sun, the
freezing cold, the harsh sea air of maritime climates, and everything in between. We test them above
and beyond anything they’ll ever experience, so they will perform above and beyond your
expectations.

### Built To Last

Each and every SolaDeck – from steel coil to finished product – is made in the USA by craftsmen that
take pride in their work. We don’t cut corners, and we stand behind every SolaDeck we sell. That’s
probably why there are units from 20+ years ago that are still in the field and going strong!

## Frequently Asked Questions
* All your questions, answered.

## What is SolarSquare?

SolarSquare designs and installs solar panel systems for homes, housing societies and businesses.

With a relentless commitment to innovation and excellence, we’re driving the Har Ghar Solar mission
forward, one rooftop at a time.

Established in 2015 by a passionate trio of solar enthusiasts — Shreya Mishra, Neeraj Jain, and
Nikhil Nahar — SolarSquare is India’s most trusted residential solar company. We believe in the
power of solar to not only reduce carbon footprints but also to revolutionise the way we power our
homes and businesses.

## What is a solar rooftop system?

A solar rooftop system is a combination of many components that convert sunlight into usable
electricity.

The components of a rooftop solar include the following –
* Solar panels with PV cells
* Solar inverter
* Solar panel mounting structures
* AC and DC cables
* AC combiner box
* DC combiner box
* Earthing cables
* MC4 connectors

## How does a solar rooftop system work?

A solar rooftop system works on the concept of conversion of sunlight into electricity. The
phenomenon is known as the photovoltaic effect.

When sunlight falls on the PV cells in a solar panel, the sunlight is converted into electricity.
The generated power is DC current. An AC combiner box is used to convert that DC power into usable
AC power.

The generated AC electricity is fed into a bidirectional meter that supplies power to the house. It
also exports excess power to the DISCOM (grid) and imports power from the grid if electricity
generated by the rooftop solar system is not enough to cover the daily requirement.

## Why should I switch to solar?

If you are dealing with high electricity bills, tapping into solar power is your best way to bring
them down. Apart from the rising cost of electricity, solar power also helps you reduce dependency
on the grid and reduce your carbon footprint.

## Is solar power safe?

**Yes**. The electricity produced by a solar power system is no different than the electricity you
get from your electricity distribution company. The only difference is the source. Moreover, it is
among the safest source of electricity consumption because it is neither hazardous nor does it
release any toxic or harmful gases during production.

## How high does my electricity bill need to be for solar to make sense for me?

We offer solar solutions for homes of all sizes. However, we’ve found that the overall investment
into a solar system works out best economically for homes with electricity bills starting at ₹1,500.

## How do I decide what size of plant I need?

The size of your Solar plant depends on the following factors
* Your electricity consumption pattern
* Available shadow free area
* Solar irradiation in your area

Once you enlist your interest in a solar project, SolarSquare conducts a scientific mapping of the
appropriate project size for you.

## How much can I actually save with solar?

Most homeowners cut their electricity bills by 80–90% from Day 1. And with rising tariffs, your
savings only keep growing every year.

## What makes SolarSquare different from other solar providers?

We handle everything for you end-to-end: design, installation, subsidy paperwork, financing, and
even offer you 5-year free maintenance. We are a no middlemen service. We are also India’s only
solar company to offer Guaranteed Savings with a money-back promise.

## I’m not sure if I have enough space for a solar system.

Not to worry. Once you share your details with us, you get a free home visit from our solar
consultant who will evaluate your space and power needs and give you a free personalised 3D rooftop
solar design for your home. You only need to proceed if you are happy with the offered solution.

## Do I need to pay a huge amount upfront?

No. With flexible EMIs starting low, you can go solar without any initial investment. The government
subsidy pays for your down payment and bill savings often cover the EMI.

## How complicated is the solar subsidy process?

We understand you may be apprehensive about the paperwork, but we manage the whole thing for you.
You won’t have to lift a finger.

## How long does it take to set up the solar system?

Once we have visited your home and you’ve approved the 3D rooftop solar design, the installation is
done in 1 day – based on your availability, the space and weather conditions.

## What is the lifespan of a rooftop solar system?

A high-quality rooftop solar system lasts 25 years or more. The panels keep generating clean power
for decades, and with SolarSquare’s 5-year free maintenance and performance checks, your system
stays in top shape throughout its life.

## Do solar panels alone guarantee long-term savings?

Panels are only one part of the system. Besides the quality of your solar panels, your long-term
savings depend on system design, strong mounting structure, and regular maintenance. If any of these
are weak, your power generation (and savings) from rooftop solar will drop over time.
With SolarSquare’s professionally engineered system and regular maintenance, you’ll enjoy
consistent, high savings for 25+ years.

## How will I know how much power my system is generating?

We have an app that’s connected to your system, where you can monitor your power generation in real
time and get 100% visibility on your savings.

## What do I need to install a rooftop solar system?

All you need to qualify for a solar system is – empty space on your roof and access to your rooftop.
Just fill the project enquiry form on our website and our team will contact you to discuss your
requirement. Once the project is finalised, we will take care of your entire plant design,
installation and maintenance.

## What are the different types of Solar systems?

There are 3 types of Solar systems depending on whether the plant is linked to the power grid or
battery systems for storage.
* On-grid solar systems use common solar inverters and are connected to the public electricity grid.
  Any excess solar power that you generate is exported to the electricity grid and one usually get
  paid a feed-in-tariff or credits for the energy you export. The policy for getting credits for
  energy exported to the credit is termed as “Net-Metering Policy” and is available currently in
  most states of India.
* Off-grid solar systems are not connected to the electricity grid and therefore requires battery
  storage. An off-grid solar system must be designed appropriately so that it will generate enough
  power throughout the year and have enough battery capacity to meet the home’s requirements, even
  in the depths of winter when there is less sunlight.
* Hybrid solar systems combines solar and battery storage in one and are now available in many
  different forms and configurations. This means being able to store solar energy that is generated
  during the day and using it at night. When the stored energy is depleted, the grid is there as
  backup, allowing consumers to have the best of both worlds.

## Frequently Asked Questions
