## What is SolarSquare?

SolarSquare designs and installs solar panel systems for homes, housing societies and businesses.

With a relentless commitment to innovation and excellence, we’re driving the Har Ghar Solar mission
forward, one rooftop at a time.

Established in 2015 by a passionate trio of solar enthusiasts — Shreya Mishra, Neeraj Jain, and
Nikhil Nahar — SolarSquare is India’s most trusted residential solar company. We believe in the
power of solar to not only reduce carbon footprints but also to revolutionise the way we power our
homes and businesses.

## What is a solar rooftop system?

A solar rooftop system is a combination of many components that convert sunlight into usable
electricity.

The components of a rooftop solar include the following –
* Solar panels with PV cells
* Solar inverter
* Solar panel mounting structures
* AC and DC cables
* AC combiner box
* DC combiner box
* Earthing cables
* MC4 connectors

## How does a solar rooftop system work?

A solar rooftop system works on the concept of conversion of sunlight into electricity. The
phenomenon is known as the photovoltaic effect.

When sunlight falls on the PV cells in a solar panel, the sunlight is converted into electricity.
The generated power is DC current. An AC combiner box is used to convert that DC power into usable
AC power.

The generated AC electricity is fed into a bidirectional meter that supplies power to the house. It
also exports excess power to the DISCOM (grid) and imports power from the grid if electricity
generated by the rooftop solar system is not enough to cover the daily requirement.

## Why should I switch to solar?

If you are dealing with high electricity bills, tapping into solar power is your best way to bring
them down. Apart from the rising cost of electricity, solar power also helps you reduce dependency
on the grid and reduce your carbon footprint.

## Is solar power safe?

**Yes**. The electricity produced by a solar power system is no different than the electricity you
get from your electricity distribution company. The only difference is the source. Moreover, it is
among the safest source of electricity consumption because it is neither hazardous nor does it
release any toxic or harmful gases during production.

## How high does my electricity bill need to be for solar to make sense for me?

We offer solar solutions for homes of all sizes. However, we’ve found that the overall investment
into a solar system works out best economically for homes with electricity bills starting at ₹1,500.

## How do I decide what size of plant I need?

The size of your Solar plant depends on the following factors
* Your electricity consumption pattern
* Available shadow free area
* Solar irradiation in your area

Once you enlist your interest in a solar project, SolarSquare conducts a scientific mapping of the
appropriate project size for you.

## How much can I actually save with solar?

Most homeowners cut their electricity bills by 80–90% from Day 1. And with rising tariffs, your
savings only keep growing every year.

## What makes SolarSquare different from other solar providers?

We handle everything for you end-to-end: design, installation, subsidy paperwork, financing, and
even offer you 5-year free maintenance. We are a no middlemen service. We are also India’s only
solar company to offer Guaranteed Savings with a money-back promise.

## I’m not sure if I have enough space for a solar system.

Not to worry. Once you share your details with us, you get a free home visit from our solar
consultant who will evaluate your space and power needs and give you a free personalised 3D rooftop
solar design for your home. You only need to proceed if you are happy with the offered solution.

## Do I need to pay a huge amount upfront?

No. With flexible EMIs starting low, you can go solar without any initial investment. The government
subsidy pays for your down payment and bill savings often cover the EMI.

## How complicated is the solar subsidy process?

We understand you may be apprehensive about the paperwork, but we manage the whole thing for you.
You won’t have to lift a finger.

## How long does it take to set up the solar system?

Once we have visited your home and you’ve approved the 3D rooftop solar design, the installation is
done in 1 day – based on your availability, the space and weather conditions.

## What is the lifespan of a rooftop solar system?

A high-quality rooftop solar system lasts 25 years or more. The panels keep generating clean power
for decades, and with SolarSquare’s 5-year free maintenance and performance checks, your system
stays in top shape throughout its life.

## Do solar panels alone guarantee long-term savings?

Panels are only one part of the system. Besides the quality of your solar panels, your long-term
savings depend on system design, strong mounting structure, and regular maintenance. If any of these
are weak, your power generation (and savings) from rooftop solar will drop over time.
With SolarSquare’s professionally engineered system and regular maintenance, you’ll enjoy
consistent, high savings for 25+ years.

## How will I know how much power my system is generating?

We have an app that’s connected to your system, where you can monitor your power generation in real
time and get 100% visibility on your savings.

## What do I need to install a rooftop solar system?

All you need to qualify for a solar system is – empty space on your roof and access to your rooftop.
Just fill the project enquiry form on our website and our team will contact you to discuss your
requirement. Once the project is finalised, we will take care of your entire plant design,
installation and maintenance.

## What are the different types of Solar systems?

There are 3 types of Solar systems depending on whether the plant is linked to the power grid or
battery systems for storage.
* On-grid solar systems use common solar inverters and are connected to the public electricity grid.
  Any excess solar power that you generate is exported to the electricity grid and one usually get
  paid a feed-in-tariff or credits for the energy you export. The policy for getting credits for
  energy exported to the credit is termed as “Net-Metering Policy” and is available currently in
  most states of India.
* Off-grid solar systems are not connected to the electricity grid and therefore requires battery
  storage. An off-grid solar system must be designed appropriately so that it will generate enough
  power throughout the year and have enough battery capacity to meet the home’s requirements, even
  in the depths of winter when there is less sunlight.
* Hybrid solar systems combines solar and battery storage in one and are now available in many
  different forms and configurations. This means being able to store solar energy that is generated
  during the day and using it at night. When the stored energy is depleted, the grid is there as
  backup, allowing consumers to have the best of both worlds.

* [[solar AC/DC hybrid air conditioner]][106]
  [12000btu 18000btu 24000btu solar hybrid air conditioner][107]
  
  The solar hybrid AC/DC air conditioner can work without battery, it works with unstable solar
  panel DC power at day time. At night or rainy days it automatically get grid AC
  power. It's  mainly used for school classroom, hospital, restaurant, shops, office… With APP
  monitor and control function through WIFI
  
  [View More][108]
* [[solar mppt controller 5 for solar power plant]][109]
  [mppt solar charge controller 192v-540v][110]
  
  The MPPT solar charge controller uses multiphase synchronous rectification technology and common
  negative pole design, it chooses high speed processor and advanced MPPT algorithm to make it has
  high response speed, high reliability and other standards. The advanced MPPT algorithm that the
  solar controller adopts can trace the maximum power point of PV arrays quickly in any situation to
  obtain the max. power from PV arrays. And the multiphase synchronous rectification technology can
  achieve high conversion efficiency in any charging environment and improve the utilization rate of
  solar power system greatly. According to the rated voltage of battery bank system, our factory can
  provide the MPPT solar charge controller from 192V to 540V which suitable to almost off grid solar
  power system
  
  [View More][111]
* [[8kw solar on/off grid inverter]][112]
  [8kw hybrid inverter with split phase output][113]
  
  An on-grid inverter’s main job is to convert DC power generated from the PV array into usable AC
  power. Hybrid inverters go a step further and work with batteries to store excess power as well.
  In the developing world, hybrid inverters are more of a necessity to compensate for weak or
  intermittent grids or a lack of grid electricity all together.
  
  [View More][114]
* [[5kw off grid mppt solar inverter]][115]
  [5kw solar power inverter for home use][116]
  
  The 5kw solar inverter is integrated with MPPT solar charge controller inside. It can also connect
  to grid to take grid as backup when battery is over discharged. The output voltage is 220V,
  maximum 6pcs in parallel. 3pcs in parallel can get three phase 380v output. All of parameter such
  as working mode, charging current, over discharge voltage can be set as you wish.
  
  [View More][117]
* [[200kW standalone solar inverter no need battery connection]][118]
  [200kW solar inverter working without battery][119]
  
  The off grid solar inverter can be put outside and work without battery. Both solar panel and grid
  are connected to the inverter, solar is priority, grid will be backup. It is very suitable for
  such situation: loads work at daytime, with grid connection. Electricity bill can be saved a lot.
  The inverter power range can be 5kw to 500kw.
  
  [View More][120]
* [[51.2V 100ah LiFePO4 5kwh Powerwall Battery]][121]
  [5kwh solar lifepo4 battery power bank][122]
  
  The Lifepo4 battery power bank is Lithium iron phosphate battery module which designed for backup
  power application. This battery module integrated with intelligent BMS inside, has big advantages
  on safety, cycle life, energy density, temperature range and environmental protection.
  Model:   51.2V 100AH or 48V100AH Rated Voltage (V):   51.2V/48V Rated Capacity (Ah):   100Ah
  Supply Ability:   5000 per Month MOQ:  1pc Certificate:   CE, IEC62619, UN38.3, MSDS,ISO9001
  
  [View More][123]
* [[3kw off grid solar system package with 120V output]][124]
  [3kw off grid solar system for US market][125]
  
  The 3kw off grid solar system is usually for home use where there is no grid or grid is unstable.
  It can supply power to normal home loads such as washing machine, LED lights, fan, air
  conditioner. Inverter power: 3kW AC output voltage: AC110V/120V Battery voltage: DC24V or DC48V
  Battery type: Gel battery or LiFePO4 battery Solar panel type: Mono or poly Compatible with grid
  and generator Monitor: WIFI or GPRS
  
  [View More][126]
* [[5kw grid tied solar system]][127]
  [5kw on grid solar power system for home use][128]
  
  The on grid solar power system converts the solar energy into electrical energy, without the
  storage battery, and directly sends the electrical energy to the grid through the grid-connected
  inverter. Inverter power: 5kW AC output voltage: single phase 220V Solar panel type: mono or poly

  maximum 6pcs in parallel. 3pcs in parallel can get three phase 380v output. All of parameter such
  as working mode, charging current, over discharge voltage can be set as you wish.

  are connected to the inverter, solar is priority, grid will be backup. It is very suitable for
  such situation: loads work at daytime, with grid connection. Electricity bill can be saved a lot.
  The inverter power range can be 5kw to 500kw.

FAQ

## Frequently Asked Questions About PV Connectors

Find answers to common questions about Treasun PV connectors, solar connectors, and photovoltaic
connection solutions

### Q1. What is a PV Connector?

A PV connector is a specialized electrical connector used in solar photovoltaic systems to safely
connect solar panels, cables, inverters, and other components. Treasun provides high-quality PV
connectors, including MC4 compatible connectors, solar cable connectors, and customized connection
solutions designed for reliable outdoor solar applications.

### Q2. What types of solar connectors does Treasun manufacture?

Treasun specializes in manufacturing various solar connection products, including PV connectors, MC4
compatible connectors, solar cable connectors, solar panel connectors, branch connectors, fuse
connectors, diode connectors, junction boxes, and wiring harness assemblies. Our products are widely
used in residential, commercial, and utility-scale solar PV systems.

### Q3. Are Treasun PV connectors compatible with MC4 connectors?

Yes. Treasun manufactures MC4 compatible connectors designed according to industry standards and
tested for reliable performance in solar PV applications. Our connectors are compatible with many
mainstream solar components and provide secure electrical connections with excellent durability and
weather resistance.

### Q4. What certifications do Treasun solar connectors have?

Treasun solar connectors are manufactured according to international quality standards and are
available with certifications including TÜV, UL, CE, and RoHS compliance. Our products are designed
to meet the requirements of global solar projects, ensuring safety, reliability, and long-term
outdoor performance.

### Q5. What voltage and current ratings are available for your PV connectors?

Treasun provides PV connectors suitable for different solar system requirements, including
high-voltage and high-current applications. Our products are available with ratings up to 1500V DC
and support various current capacities according to customer requirements. Customized solutions are
also available for specific solar projects.

### Q6. Can Treasun provide OEM and customized solar connector solutions?

Yes. As a professional PV connector manufacturer in China, Treasun provides OEM and customized solar
connection solutions, including product design, connector customization, cable assembly, and
packaging solutions. We work with global distributors, solar installers, and renewable energy
companies to meet different market requirements.

### Q1. What is a PV Connector?

A PV connector is a specialized electrical connector used in solar photovoltaic systems to safely
connect solar panels, cables, inverters, and other components. Treasun provides high-quality PV
connectors, including MC4 compatible connectors, solar cable connectors, and customized connection
solutions designed for reliable outdoor solar applications.

### Q2. What types of solar connectors does Treasun manufacture?

Treasun specializes in manufacturing various solar connection products, including PV connectors, MC4
compatible connectors, solar cable connectors, solar panel connectors, branch connectors, fuse
connectors, diode connectors, junction boxes, and wiring harness assemblies. Our products are widely
used in residential, commercial, and utility-scale solar PV systems.

### Q3. Are Treasun PV connectors compatible with MC4 connectors?

Yes. Treasun manufactures MC4 compatible connectors designed according to industry standards and
tested for reliable performance in solar PV applications. Our connectors are compatible with many
mainstream solar components and provide secure electrical connections with excellent durability and
weather resistance.

### Q4. What certifications do Treasun solar connectors have?

Treasun solar connectors are manufactured according to international quality standards and are
available with certifications including TÜV, UL, CE, and RoHS compliance. Our products are designed
to meet the requirements of global solar projects, ensuring safety, reliability, and long-term
outdoor performance.

### Q5. What voltage and current ratings are available for your PV connectors?

Treasun provides PV connectors suitable for different solar system requirements, including
high-voltage and high-current applications. Our products are available with ratings up to 1500V DC
and support various current capacities according to customer requirements. Customized solutions are
also available for specific solar projects.

### Q6. Can Treasun provide OEM and customized solar connector solutions?

Yes. As a professional PV connector manufacturer in China, Treasun provides OEM and customized solar
connection solutions, including product design, connector customization, cable assembly, and
packaging solutions. We work with global distributors, solar installers, and renewable energy
companies to meet different market requirements.

## Electrical Solutions for Every Need

As a trusted electrical equipment manufacturer, VIOX delivers high-performance electrical solutions
designed for residential, commercial, industrial, and renewable energy applications—providing cost
savings, operational efficiency, and reliability across diverse industries worldwide.

### Solar & Renewable Energy Systems

The solar sector relies on specialized DC components for safe high-voltage management and surge
protection in photovoltaic systems.

### Industrial Manufacturing & Automation

Industrial manufacturing requires robust electrical controls for heavy machinery and automation
systems.

### Commercial & Residential Buildings

Buildings need electrical solutions prioritizing safety and efficiency while meeting codes.

### Marine & Offshore Industries

Marine applications require components withstanding saltwater, humidity, and vibration.
